description: For one target of the draft, where each of the person's fields comes from: sure (with a proposal), choose (with candidates) or unknown. Turn each sure item into a mapping for save_draft: a proposal of kind "map" becomes {"target", "source"} with its where, value_map or classify; kind "direct" becomes {"target", "source": null}. Ask the person about the ones marked choose and unknown.
